svg.title: Enrollment and device lifecycle state connections
svg.desc: Inputs, outputs, durable state, evidence, failure, and recovery relationships for Enrollment and device lifecycle state.

g.text: Enrollment and device lifecycle state connections

a.xlink:title: Enrollment and device lifecycle state. Retains enrolled devices across connectivity loss and separates durable enrollment, current state, health, supervisor state, and recovery history.
Invite and identity lifecycle. Tracks pending, accepted, revoked, blocked, and consumed invite/identity state with duplicate and mismatch guards.
SQLite control-plane store. Stores canonical Lite lifecycle state and prepared projections; the frontend never accesses it directly.
Heartbeat, telemetry, and health publishers. Publish fresh runtime signals used to derive Online, Offline, Stale, Agent stopped, and Remote access not ready states.
NATS / JetStream. Provides the command and event backbone with durable delivery; it is never contacted directly by the frontend.
